✨ mimik | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Creating documentation, tutorials, and onboarding guides for browser-based tasks and workflows.
✨ Key Features: • Auto-capture of browser workflows (clicks, keystrokes, navigation) • Automatic generation of step-by-step guides with annotated screenshots • Smart blur for sensitive data (emails, SSNs, credit cards, etc.) • Manual blur picker for custom elements • AI-generated descriptions (optional)
📖 Summary: Mimik is a browser extension that automatically records user workflows, capturing clicks, keystrokes, and navigation to generate step-by-step guides with annotated screenshots. It prioritizes privacy with a local-first, no-account, no-tracking approach.
